subject: [PATCH 07/60] mm/memory-tiers: restrict demotion topology to common memory

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: The original patch author posted a duplicate of their own patch with no changes or additional comments. This is likely an error and not a substantive contribution to the discussion.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch restricts the demotion topology to common memory, preventing nodes outside N_MEMORY_COMMON from being generic demotion sources or destinations. It also updates various functions to use N_MEMORY_COMMON instead of every node that has memory.
